snippets.BALLROOM_GRAVE_SPEECH_01: Hello $$name$$! We wish you a spooky Halloween!
snippets.BALLROOM_GRAVE_SPEECH_02: Psst... I heard that if there are more than 10 pandas in the ballroom, they all turn into bats!
snippets.HELP_SIGN_01: Click and hold on the swimming tire next to the clown to pump it up, but don't click too long or it'll explode!
snippets.HELP_SIGN_02: Every time you come to the lake, you have to get a new swimming tire.
snippets.HELP_SIGN_LEVELBOOSTER_01: This is the magical level booster! This machine automatically advances your Panda to the next level on a random day. You never know which day it will be, so make sure you stop by every day!
snippets.HINT_RACINGTRACK_01: Click on one of the cars to drive it around Panfu. Bring the car back here when you're done with it. Sorry, but only Gold Pandas are allowed to drive.
snippets.LFT_BIRD: Get the golden hat! Click on the billboard!
snippets.PANDIMC_INTROSPEECH_01: Aye, $$name$$! Nice to meet you. If you have a music request, click on the mixer.
snippets.TROY_DEFAULTSPEECH_01: If you want a pancake, just click on the pancake in the pan. You can do that, I believe in you!
snippets.TROY_DEFAULTSPEECH_02: Once you get a pancake, you will not get another one for an hour. I also need a break.
snippets.TROY_INTROSPEECH_01: Excellent, $$name$$. They call me Troy and I provide Panfu with delicious pancakes. Paul the Kid is my best customer, but maybe you will be able to take his place?
snippets.UNICORN_HINT_02: You can only ride the unicorn with a special saddle. Ask the horse trainer Horsey for it. You will find Horsey at the Stables.
